notes: Revenu Québec and LégisQuébec return HTTP 403 to this environment; every cited page was read from its Internet Archive snapshot (revenuquebec pages 2025-08 to 2026-07; QST Act consolidation snapshot 2025-06-24). The rule predates 2013-04-01 (QST at 9.975% and QST/GST harmonization took effect 2013-01-01) and continues; 2013-04-01 is OpenTaxRate's Canadian start date.
